notes.title: The Russian translation has been updated, and it will be more down-to-earth!
notes.notes: Thank Maksin and Zverobob very much for providing very down-to-earth Russian support for "The Adventures of Max"! In addition, some minor bugs have been fixed and the jumping operation experience has been slightly increased. Enjoy!

notes.title: "Mess Adventures 2" is coming soon!
notes.notes:
The store page of "Mess Adventures 2" is now open! Everyone is welcome to browse and add to the wish list!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1520850/2/

Our gorgeous young Linda is abducted again by Mr Strong, that Little Mess has to be continuing his journey of rescuing her.  However there is a stronger guy who is stronger than Mr. Strong abducts Linda a second time, then both Little Mess and Mr Strong will be combining temporarily against this common enemy.

"Mess Adventures 2" will remains the previous nonsensical style, and it would be the best choice for teasing your friends, any game anchors, or even entertain yourself...

The game is expected to meet everyone in the summer of 2021! Everyone, go and add to the wish list to see how the strong Mr. Strong was crushed!
